evidence.observation: Baseline after purge ~4-6 ppm through ramp and early growth (k=4..21)
Temperature holds 750 °C at setpoint, heater power steady ~44%, no thermal anomaly
Ar flow 99-100 sccm on setpoint and pressure ~760 Torr stable, so the O2 rise is not a flow or exhaust-pressure event

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2 trend (further rise vs. plateau), and a leak-check/pressure-decay or Ar-flow step test to confirm air ingress rather than an O2 sensor drift; post-growth characterization of the film.

spoken: O₂ has climbed monotonically from ~5 to 32 ppm during growth while T, Ar, and P stay on setpoint — consistent with an air ingress/seal leak.
